title: Sotsiaal.pro vestlus: kolm juhtumit, 75 küsimust (pöörduja, sotsiaaltöötaja, teenuseosutaja) — eelregistreering
owner: Owner 21.10.2026: "Koosta 3 juhtumit … Kolm eraldi vestlust. kokku küsimusi nt 75. Minu luba on antud raha kulutada. Teeme hiljem analüüsi, et mis andmebaasist leiti ja vastati."
server: sotsiaal.pro after the ADR-157 deploy (dialogue prompt m4-grounded-dialogue-47, search-assist-15)
costCap: owner allowed spending; the runner stops at 2.00 USD; expected 0.5-0.8 USD

method.conversations: one conversation per case (A, B, C); each role (help seeker, social worker, provider) starts a new topic in it (contextMode new) and then continues it (same); the view role is set for each role and restored to none at the end
method.entry: POST /api/chat with x-rag-pilot: 1 (full turn) from the owner's signed-in ADMIN session
method.capture: answer (kind, blocks with refs, limitations, clarification), sources with titles and provisions (cited text in full), cost, and from /admin/rag/chat-trace: the AI search variants, places, lanes, the selection pool size and picks, each evidence passage's reason, the additions
method.persons: all persons are invented; municipalities are real so that the municipal records are searched
method.grading: later, by the owner's analysis: what the database held and what was answered; the expected points are the questioner's, not drawn from the corpus, and are a checklist, not a key. A "cannot be said" answer where the corpus holds the answer is a fault (owner 21.10).
method.crisis: four turns (B07, C09, C13, C22) concern danger or suicidal thoughts; the JSON route shows the answer, the application shows emergency contacts separately
